name: figma-to-markdown
description: Node.js backend service that reads Figma designs via the REST API and renders them as structured JSON and Markdown.

scripts.test: node tests/extractors.test.js && node tests/normalizer.test.js && node tests/markdownRenderer.test.js

_notes.zero-deps: logger.js and config/index.js are zero-dependency implementations. To use winston + dotenv instead: npm install winston dotenv, then swap the two files per the comments inside them.
_notes.optional-upgrades: winston (structured logging), dotenv (env loading), ioredis (Redis cache), helmet (security headers)
